notes.title: The Flesh God is going free
notes.notes:
Hello!

The Flesh God is becoming a free game in a couple of days. We don't know the exact date since is out of our hands, but we expect it to happen soon.

We want to thank all the players who helped us by buying the game. Now that the studio has been closed for several years, we want to put the game for free as a testament of our work, so everyone can play it.

We will update you when the transition is done.

notes.title: Achievements fixed
notes.notes:
We have been testing the game with your feedback and we have found problems with some achievements which have been fixed.

We have also detected some bugs with the leaderboards (when showing your friends) and they have also been fixed.
